text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —*pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Hah, it's hard to breathe...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Dammit, I lost...!! *cough*, *pant*—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't push yourself! Here, take a 
deep breath!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Tamamo-senpai. You saved me back 
there...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Senpai?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I was just so frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You started making a name for yourself 
first, while I just kept smoldering on and 
on...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, I finally got stronger, and reached 
a point where I could run shoulder to 
shoulder with ya. Yet, by that time, you 
were—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—You lost your fighting spirit. The 
fiercely burning you wasn't there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's about keeping up 
appearances or what, but let's not get 
jerked around by such nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Watching you stumble around like that... 
it was just so frustrating, I couldn't 
stand it...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Tamamo-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But both in the Tenno Sho (Spring) and 
today, you've changed. I felt your true 
determination... way more than ever 
before.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're lookin' pretty good right now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, decided on your next race yet? If 
not—come to the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That legendary Oguri Cap is running in 
that one.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ! "The Monster" Oguri Cap...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's an absolute monster from a 
generation below us. Taking her on won't 
be a walk in the park!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She set a track record at Tokyo Racecourse 
this year, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And that's with a faster time than the 
Yasuda Kinen on the very same turf 1600m 
track. You get what that means, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...She's faster... than even the 
Senior-year runners competing at the GⅠ 
level."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If ya wanna go all-out, she's a great 
match. Besides, you wanna get your revenge 
on me too, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Look who's talking.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll take down both you and Oguri 
together. You'd better show up, City!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Also, listen.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Saying you ‘just wanna run’ is pretty 
childish, but it's just like ya."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Tamamo-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Upon Gold City's return, she expressed 
her desire to challenge the Japan Cup... 
and the race that would showcase the 
culmination of her efforts was set!
